column4: notes
ExecStartPre/Post and ExecStop move into run/finish; StartLimitBurst is an accepted loss (doctor-side detection instead); KillMode=process is natural under runsv
same StartLimitBurst loss; MALLOC_CONF exported in run
Restart=on-failure becomes a finish script (exit 0 parks, non-zero restarts)
same on-failure finish translation; TimeoutStopSec has no runit analogue (sv down waits for the run child)
PartOf=pipewire becomes a dbus-name wait plus finish downs the service when pipewire is gone
After/Wants/PartOf=bluetooth becomes a dbus-name wait for org.freedesktop.DBus plus a bluetoothd readiness check; the tail -f stdin hold is kept
loop service: the timer's schedule becomes a run loop with env-overridable delays
OnBootSec/OnUnitActiveSec/Persistent fold into the loop service above; runit has no timer units
loop service: the timer's schedule becomes a run loop with env-overridable delays; rashin routines wake decides on each pass whether to start the daemon
OnStartupSec/OnUnitActiveSec fold into the loop service above; runit has no timer units; the daemon enables the service while a routine is on
oneshot: run does the work then exec sv down; ConditionPathExists markers kept; the session entrypoint restarts it before the rest of the user-service roster
Profiles are available only on Arch and CachyOS; Void does not run profile launcher scoping
Profiles are available only on Arch and CachyOS; Void does not watch application directories for profile scoping
Profiles are available only on Arch and CachyOS; Void has no profile account session resources
runit has no targets; session activation rows define the ordered roster that ryoku-host writes for each user
the drop-in's Wants/After=ryoku-bootstrap is folded into the roster ordering, where bootstrap runs first
UnsetEnvironment=GDK_BACKEND is a systemd drop-in on a foreign unit; Void portals are D-Bus activated and do not use this user-manager drop-in
environment-generator protocol replaced by a Turnstile envdir renderer

the user manager's environment.d reader becomes a profile.d hook (/etc/profile.d/ryoku-environment-d.sh) that SDDM's session script sources before the compositor; command substitution, quotes and backslashes are rejected because the hook runs in every login shell
Void clients start rashind directly when Rashin is enabled; runit does not own a daemon service
Void clients start rashind directly when Rashin is enabled; the daemon lock prevents concurrent starts
After=graphical-session becomes a WAYLAND_DISPLAY wait; user service (the systemd original is per-user despite living under packaging/)
graphical-session and PipeWire ordering become bounded waits; Restart=on-failure becomes a finish script and the service stays on demand

DefaultDependencies=no plus After=local-fs/network: runit stage 2 already implies local-fs; the network wait stays (nm-online inside boot-guard itself); Before=display-manager has no runit analogue (accepted loss: runit starts sddm in parallel, the guard is idempotent)
After=display-manager has no runit analogue; the guard acts only once the sddm daemon is running, so starting beside it is equivalent
oneshot service that creates the /var/lib/ryoku tree with the same modes; Void has no tmpfiles.d
OnBootSec=10min and OnUnitActiveSec=1d become a loop around Void snapper's packaged cron cleanup
Before=network-pre/NetworkManager has no runit analogue; the guard runs as early as stage 2 allows and the residual race is recorded (firewall up before NM's first interface bind in practice)
Requires=guard becomes a wait on the guard's parked supervise state; WantedBy=NetworkManager.service is dropped (runit has no wants)
the shared reset helper selects sv restart bluetoothd on runit, then restores the user's saved radio state; Void lacks systemd-rfkill boot restore, so the state is restored at session start

a D-Bus activation file, not a systemd unit; it routes Secret Service activation to the socket-backed systemd user unit and ships only on systemd editions, Void keeps gnome-keyring's own D-Bus activation
org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units does not exist under runit; the Void path restarts bluetoothd via sv as root from the session wrapper, no polkit grant needed
archiso live-image units (pacman-init, firstboot, timesyncd, getty, NetworkManager); the Void ISO has its own runit live-image service set
